## Coverage of the spec

- Resources of the spec that are **not implemented**: `/hub`, `/listener` (`/hub` and `/listener/*`: no event notifications).


## Behaviour and deviations

Categories form a single-parent hierarchy. Edit parent; subCategory and isRoot are
derived. Catalogs reference roots only. Cycles and reparenting a catalog root are
refused (409). Category productOffering and catalog category arrays replace membership;
[] clears them, PATCH null is refused. ProductOffering.category is read-only.
See [the catalog decision](../decisions/catalog.md#categories-and-product-catalogs-2026-10-16).

| Rule | Code | Proven by |
|---|---|---|
| A price is created on its own (unattached) and attached through the offering's `productOfferingPrice[]` on POST or PATCH. **Deviation:** only references are accepted there, not inline prices (an entry without `id` is a 422) | `app/api/catalog.py` (`_attach_prices`, `OfferingCreate`) | `tests/test_api_catalog.py::test_prices_attach_on_create_and_on_patch` |
| A price belongs to at most one offering (409) and never overlaps a price of the same offering, type and currency (409, exclusion constraint) | `_attach_prices`; `product_offering_price_no_overlap` | `::test_a_price_belongs_to_at_most_one_offering`, `::test_overlapping_prices_cannot_be_attached_to_one_offering` |
| A price is never detached: a PATCH whose `productOfferingPrice[]` drops one is a 409 | `patch_offering` | `::test_a_price_is_never_detached` |
| A price is never re-priced: `price`, `priceType`, `recurringChargePeriodType`, `recurringChargePeriodLength` are read-only (400); `validFor.startDateTime` cannot move (409) | `PRICE_IMMUTABLE`, `patch_price` | `::test_changing_a_price_means_ending_it_and_attaching_a_new_one` |
| A price never starts in the past: created or attached with `validFor.startDateTime` < now is a 409 | `create_price`, `_not_in_the_past` | `::test_a_price_cannot_start_in_the_past` |
| A price is never ended retroactively: the end can only be set or moved to >= now, and only while the current end is not in the past (409) | `patch_price` | `::test_a_price_cannot_be_ended_retroactively` |
| Ending a recurring price never leaves a product without one (D-W18): 409 unless a price of the same offering, type and currency starts exactly at the new end, or every not-cancelled/aborted product of the offering in that currency is terminated by the first business date the price no longer covers | `_no_gap`, `_first_uncovered_day` | `tests/test_api_price_gap.py` (all five tests) |
| The `lifecycleStatus` of an offering, a specification and a price only moves forward: In Design -> Active -> Retired; Retired is final; anything else is a 409 and nothing in that PATCH is applied; repeating the current status is fine. POST may create any of them in any status | `LIFECYCLE_STEPS`, `_check_lifecycle` | `tests/test_api_offering_lifecycle.py::test_every_transition`, `::test_a_refused_transition_changes_nothing_else_in_the_patch`, `tests/test_api_catalog_lifecycle.py::test_every_transition` |
| An offering's `validFor` is never rewritten in the past: PATCH may not move `startDateTime` to before now, nor set or move `endDateTime` to before now (409, nothing applied); repeating the current value is fine. Billing never reads it (only new orders do, `offeringNotValid`), so ending an offering leaves its live products priced | `_check_offering_period` | `tests/test_api_offering_validity.py` |
| Offering code: `externalIdentifier[]` with exactly one `{id, externalIdentifierType: "offeringCode", owner: "bss"}`; `^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]{0,31}$`; unique (409); optional; set on POST only (read-only after, 400); an offering without one has no `externalIdentifier` | `OfferingCode`, `create_offering` | `tests/test_api_credit_limit_and_code.py::test_code_is_stored_as_external_identifier_and_unique`, `::test_invalid_codes`, `::test_the_code_is_read_only_after_creation`, `::test_an_offering_without_a_code_has_no_external_identifier` |
| `productSpecification` is mandatory on an offering (ours) and read-only on PATCH | `OfferingCreate`, `patch_offering` | `tests/test_api_catalog.py::test_offering_needs_an_existing_specification` |
| Prices are monthly only: `recurringChargePeriodType` `monthly` (required for recurring, not allowed for oneTime), `recurringChargePeriodLength` 1 | `PriceCreate` | `::test_price_validation` |
| `lastUpdate` is accepted and ignored on POST (the spec's `_FVO` schemas make clients send it), read-only on PATCH | `last_update` fields | `tests/test_api_conventions.py::test_patch_rejects_read_only_attributes` |
| DELETE (204) only what nothing references, else 409 naming the references: a specification no offering uses; an offering never ordered (no product, no order item - rejected ones included) and without prices; a price that is unattached or whose offering was never ordered; a category without subcategories, offerings or catalogs; any catalog (its root memberships go, the categories stay). An offering's category memberships go with it | `refuse_if_referenced`, `delete_*` in `catalog.py` and `classification.py` | `tests/test_api_catalog_delete.py::test_an_ordered_offering_and_its_prices_stay`, `::test_an_unordered_offering_goes_after_its_prices`, `::test_category_and_catalog_rules` |
| importJob/exportJob: the catalog as a `BssCatalogDocument` in a `data:application/json;base64,...` URL; the server fetches and writes nothing else (another `url` is a 422). Synchronous: 201 with status `Succeeded` or `Failed`; `errorLog` is the reason as text. Export `query`: empty or `productCatalog.id=<id>`. Import: POST's rules, the source's ids, all or nothing; identical existing entries are skipped, different ones fail the job. Deleting a job undoes nothing | `app/api/catalog_jobs.py` | `tests/test_api_catalog_jobs.py` |
| A delete and an order (or a new offering) never race: orders hold their offerings `FOR SHARE`, offering POST its specification; deletes lock the row (a price: its offering) `FOR UPDATE` | `lock_offering`, `lock_product_specification` | `::test_a_price_delete_waits_for_an_order_in_flight`, `::test_an_order_waits_for_a_price_delete_in_flight`, `::test_a_new_offering_waits_for_a_specification_delete_in_flight` |

Changing the price of a live offering cannot be done with these operations (neither
order of "end" and "attach" works while a product is live, proven by
`tests/test_internal_price_change.py::test_tmf620_cannot_change_a_live_price_in_either_order`);
it is the internal operation `POST /internal/v1/productOffering/{id}/priceChange`, see
[internal.md](internal.md).

In these notes `::test_name` is a test in the test file named last before it. Hand-written: [`scripts/docs/api-notes/tmf620-product-catalog.md`](../../scripts/docs/api-notes/tmf620-product-catalog.md).


## Errors

Every non-2xx body is the TMF630 `Error`: `{"@type": "Error", "code", "reason", "message", "status"}` (`app/api/errors.py`), also for unknown routes, FastAPI's own validation errors and unhandled exceptions (500 says "internal error" only). Status codes: 400 malformed JSON, unknown or read-only attribute, bad query parameter; 404 unknown id or path; 405 unsupported method; 409 conflict with stored state; 415 wrong content type; 422 well-formed but invalid. 415 and 422 are ours: the TMF specs do not declare them. See [README.md](README.md#conventions).
